title.en: Keep the Water, Remove the Magnet

brief.zh: 给观测员的包内只能有 1 瓶水。草稿已经有 1 瓶水，但还列了 1 块磁铁。请 AI 修好草稿。
brief.en: An observer's bag must contain exactly 1 bottle of water. The draft already lists the water, but it also includes 1 magnet. Ask AI to fix the draft.

concept.zh: 明确排除草稿中不允许的项目，同时保留正确数量。
concept.en: Explicitly exclude a forbidden entry from the draft while preserving the correct count.

hints.zh: 只说“保留水”会使磁铁继续留在清单里。
hints.en: Saying only “Keep the water” leaves the magnet in the list.

en: Remove the magnet. Keep 1 water bottle.
